name: luxor-obelisk
coordinate_method: Published point, not GNSS survey. Heading and minor dimensions marked as estimates below.
geometry_notes: The obelisk is23m including its golden summit. Pink Aswan granite tapers above a Breton granite pedestal modeled8.4m above the current pavement; the city history gives9m for the complete pedestal. Repeated carved-sign shadows represent the three vertical hieroglyph columns per face, with no claim to transcribe the inscriptions. Gilt pyramidion contrasts with the rose-brown granite and grey-pink pedestal.
placement_notes: Monument coordinate approximately48.86563,2.32124. Heading32 degrees aligns pedestal approximately to Place de la Concorde. The existing pedestal provides the support geometry; surrounding roads and ground remain unchanged.

grounding.datum: Surveyed anchor with rigid component offsets from raw production elevation
grounding.terrain_modification: None. Terrain shape and material remain unchanged. Only authored geometry moves and its buried supports extend to sampled ground.
grounding.components: One connected column and its footing

rights: All mesh geometry and surface tinting originally authored for Low Poly Earth. No third-party mesh, texture, photograph or inscription artwork is incorporated.
